answer: One applicant claims a ledge, locks an 80-credit bond, and files one crystal with a serial, a hardness reading, and the plume-vent log entry. Auditors check the reading against the Mohs table for the kind and verify the vent entry and serial are unused and match the ledge log; mismatch or reuse burns the bond. First costs 43, the kth costs 43+7(k-1), so the 1000th costs 7036 and 1000 fakes cost 3,539,500 plus 80,000 locked. A rented-crystal ring fails because one specimen and one vent entry support one filing. An honest applicant files once, pays 43, and keeps the bond.
